# RITSEI v0.3.0

RITSEI v0.3.0 is a **pre-release**, **source-only** snapshot. It carries the
Node.js LTS 24 and pnpm 12.14.0 **toolchain migration** from Deno and has no
published build artifact, package distribution, or supported **upgrade** path.

- The toolchain migrates to Node.js v24.22.0 and pnpm 12.14.0; validation,
  formatting, bundling, and CI move to the pnpm command surface documented in
  ADR-0087.
- The Solid 2.0-rc.6 package pairing is carried through pnpm workspace
  overrides.
- Production artifact bundles (API, worker, migrator, frontend, migrations)
  build from `pnpm run production:artifacts`; the artifact path stays separate
  from production eligibility.

Upgrade from v0.2.0 is not supported; re-clone and run pnpm install.
